description:
Create a ClockNext customer — the entity you bill (maps to one of your end-users / tenants / organisations).

Rules:
- `name` and `email` are required; everything else is optional profile.
- Returns the customer `id` — pass it as `customerId` to clocknext_create_purchase and to the signals your product code sends.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 (3 letters); must be enabled for the org. Defaults to the org currency.

description.description: Optional freeform description of the customer.

email.description: Primary email — required, and the key bulk import matches back on.

legalName.description: Registered legal name (for invoices), when it differs from `name`.

logoUrl.description: URL of the customer's logo image.

taxId.description: Tax identifier shown on invoices (VAT / GST / EIN…).

name: clocknext_create_customer
title: ClockNext: create customer
